proposal.title: Convert CP/M for Tandy Model II to technology-style specification chapters
proposal.reason: Preserve every existing specification description, relationship role and referenced ID in numbered chapters with named text parameters. Add the commercial offering kind and documented providers. Where supplied, release is a direct date already stated in the product or the supported Model II customer-release event. No sales forecasts or new standards-impact assessments are invented.

before.name: CP/M for Tandy Model II
before.description: DRI CP/M supplied for the Tandy Model II cooperation configuration, with Model II boot/disk/printer BIOS, a native display/keyboard TUI adapter, bounded clipboard and required application services. Tandy sells and supports the configuration, DRI supplies CP/M, and AION funds, qualifies and maintains the port under the cooperation agreement. This is CP/M-80 work and does not imply an x86 CP/M commitment.

specification.description: DRI supplies CP/M and required platform services.
Tandy sells and supports CP/M on its Model II configuration.
Defines the Model II CP/M implementation and its platform requirements.
This edition targets the Tandy Model II cooperation configuration.
Allocates the porting, qualification, distribution and support responsibilities.
